conventions: TypeScript strict mode across monorepo packages (@excalidraw/common, @excalidraw/element, @excalidraw/excalidraw) and excalidraw-app.
Formatting via Prettier (npx prettier --check / --write) and linting via ESLint (yarn eslint --max-warnings=0).

Default page ID is the fixed constant DEFAULT_PAGE_ID = "page-default" and default page name is DEFAULT_PAGE_NAME = "Page 1" in @excalidraw/common; never call randomId(), randomInteger(), or Math.random() when creating the default page on mount, restore, or legacy load, or when creating elements.

Elements on the default page omit pageId (or treat undefined as DEFAULT_PAGE_ID) so single-page element objects and snapshots remain unchanged; elements created on non-default pages have pageId set to the active page ID.

Existing snapshot files (__snapshots__/) are never hand-edited and never updated with a blanket yarn test:update; only the 3 affected test files (contextmenu.test.tsx, history.test.tsx, regressionTests.test.tsx) are updated individually via tooling units.
Only packages/excalidraw/locales/en.json is edited for localization strings; other locale files are managed by Crowdin.
Tests use Vitest and @testing-library/react with the shared window.h harness and API helper from packages/excalidraw/tests/helpers/api.ts.

decisions.choice: Option A: optional pageId?: string on _ExcalidrawElementBase with DEFAULT_PAGE_ID ("page-default") fallback, a single master elements array in Scene, active-page filtering on Scene canvas queries (getNonDeletedElements, getElementsIncludingDeleted), and all-page accessors (getAllElementsIncludingDeleted, getAllElementsMapIncludingDeleted, getAllNonDeletedElements) for persistence, serialization, search, and collaboration.
rejected: Option B: Record<PageId, ExcalidrawElement[]> map in Scene
decisions.reason: Confirmed by user at Gate 1; keeps flat element array compatibility for .excalidraw files, Store, and collaboration.

decisions.topic: Collaboration page list persistence and backend export
decisions.choice: Store the room's page list as its own encrypted field (pagesCiphertext and pagesIv) on the Firebase room document in excalidraw-app/data/firebase.ts alongside elements, load it back on join and reload, and send every page's elements plus the page list in share links and Excalidraw+ exports (onExportToBackend and exportToExcalidrawPlus).
decisions.reason: Persists page metadata across room reloads and late joins without polluting the elements array, and ensures shared links and Excalidraw+ exports carry all pages.

decisions.choice: History.record(delta) files each HistoryDelta into the undo stack of the page whose elements the delta changes (resolved from the changed elements' pageId in Scene/Store, falling back to activePageId only when no element pageId is present), rather than the page active when Store commits.
rejected: Filing undo entries by the activePageId at Store commit time
Single shared undo/redo stack across all pages
decisions.reason: Prevents an edit committed around a page switch from landing on another page's undo stack.

decisions.choice: actionDeletePage marks every element belonging to the deleted page as isDeleted: true with bumped version and versionNonce (newElementWith(el, { isDeleted: true })) instead of removing them from the elements array.
rejected: Filtering deleted page's elements out of the master array
decisions.reason: Preserves element tombstones so collaborators reconcile and delete the page's elements too.

decisions.choice: Save scrollX, scrollY, and zoom into the outgoing page entry in appState.pages only when leaving a page (switch, create, or delete), not from App.componentDidUpdate on every scroll or zoom.
rejected: Calling setState in App.componentDidUpdate whenever scrollX, scrollY, or zoom changes
decisions.reason: Avoids extra setState calls in componentDidUpdate so render counts remain unchanged.

decisions.topic: Embedded scene in image exports (SVG/PNG embedScene)
decisions.choice: SVG and PNG embedScene metadata serializes only the exported active page's elements and strips pages and activePageId from the embedded appState, while saved .excalidraw files serialize all pages' elements and appState.pages / appState.activePageId.
rejected: Embedding all pages and pages/activePageId into PNG/SVG embedScene metadata
decisions.reason: Single-page image exports carry only the exported page's scene and keep export.test.tsx.snap unchanged.

units.behaviour: Store and load the encrypted page list on the Firebase collaboration room document alongside encrypted elements.
rules: 1. Add optional pagesIv?: Bytes; and pagesCiphertext?: Bytes; fields to FirebaseStoredScene.

2. Add encryptPages(key: string, pages: AppState["pages"]): Promise<{ pagesCiphertext: ArrayBuffer; pagesIv: Uint8Array }> and decryptPages(pagesIv: Bytes, pagesCiphertext: Bytes, roomKey: string): Promise<AppState["pages"] | undefined> using encryptData and decryptData.

3. Update FirebaseSceneVersionCache to track both sceneVersion and pagesSignature (JSON of pages id and name) per socket, and accept optional appState?: Pick<AppState, "pages"> in isSavedToFirebase(portal, elements, appState) so page list changes also trigger saving to Firebase.

4. In createFirebaseSceneDocument, accept optional pages?: AppState["pages"] and, when pages && pages.length > 0, encrypt pages with roomKey and store pagesIv: Bytes.fromUint8Array(pagesIv) and pagesCiphertext: Bytes.fromUint8Array(new Uint8Array(pagesCiphertext)) on the document.

5. In saveToFirebase, pass appState to isSavedToFirebase; when creating a new room document pass appState.pages to createFirebaseSceneDocument; when updating an existing room document decrypt prevStoredPages via decryptPages(prevDocData.pagesIv, prevDocData.pagesCiphertext, roomKey) if present, reconcile remote pages with appState.pages (or use appState.pages), encrypt and store the updated pages on nextDocData, and attach (storedElements as any).pages = storedPages before returning storedElements.

6. In loadFromFirebase, when storedScene.pagesIv && storedScene.pagesCiphertext are present, decrypt them via decryptPages(storedScene.pagesIv, storedScene.pagesCiphertext, roomKey) and attach (elements as any).pages = pages on the returned elements array.

units.behaviour: Synchronize all pages' elements and page metadata across collaborators and Firebase room storage while keeping each collaborator's activePageId and viewport local.
rules: 1. Import DEFAULT_PAGE_ID from @excalidraw/common, getElementPageId from @excalidraw/element, and ExcalidrawPage from @excalidraw/excalidraw/types.

2. Add private lastBroadcastedOrReceivedPagesJSON = "" on Collab and a helper getPagesSignature(pages: readonly ExcalidrawPage[]) returning JSON.stringify(pages.map((p) => ({ id: p.id, name: p.name }))).

3. In onUnload, pass this.excalidrawAPI.getAppState() as the third argument to isSavedToFirebase; in saveCollabRoomToFirebase, pass (storedElements as { pages?: AppState["pages"] }).pages as the second argument to this.handleRemoteSceneUpdate.
4. In the idle detector (onIdleStateChange), read all non-deleted elements across pages via this.excalidrawAPI.getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted().filter((el) => !el.isDeleted).

5. When receiving WS_SUBTYPES.INIT or WS_SUBTYPES.UPDATE, pass decryptedData.payload.pages as the second argument to this.handleRemoteSceneUpdate; in WS_SUBTYPES.INIT, also pass appState: decryptedData.payload.pages ? { pages: this.excalidrawAPI.getAppState().pages, activePageId: this.excalidrawAPI.getAppState().activePageId } : undefined in scenePromise.resolve.

6. In initializeRoom (fetchScene), read const loadedPages = (elements as { pages?: AppState["pages"] }).pages; update this.lastBroadcastedOrReceivedPagesJSON = loadedPages ? getPagesSignature(loadedPages) : ""; and include appState: loadedPages && loadedPages.length > 0 ? { pages: loadedPages, activePageId: loadedPages[0].id } : undefined in the returned object.

7. In handleRemoteSceneUpdate(elements, remotePages?: AppState["pages"]), if remotePages && remotePages.length > 0, reconcile remotePages with localAppState.pages by preserving local scrollX/scrollY/zoom for existing page ids, keeping any local pages whose non-deleted elements exist in elements, keeping local activePageId if it still exists in nextPages (otherwise falling back to nextPages[0].id and updating scrollX/scrollY/zoom to nextPages[0]), and passing appState: { pages: nextPages, activePageId: nextActivePageId, ... } alongside elements to this.excalidrawAPI.updateScene; update this.lastBroadcastedOrReceivedPagesJSON.

8. In queueBroadcastAllElements, also call this.portal.broadcastScene(WS_SUBTYPES.UPDATE, this.excalidrawAPI.getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted(), true) when getPagesSignature(this.excalidrawAPI.getAppState().pages) !== this.lastBroadcastedOrReceivedPagesJSON, and update this.lastBroadcastedOrReceivedPagesJSON in broadcastElements.

units.behaviour: Preserve multi-page state and elements across localStorage, collab room join, share links, and Excalidraw+ exports.
rules: 1. Import restoreAppState and restoreElements from @excalidraw/excalidraw.

2. In initializeScene, when restoring from localStorage or a backend share link (#json=), restore appState first via restoreAppState and pass validPageIds: appState.pages.map((p) => p.id) and defaultPageId: appState.pages[0]?.id to restoreElements so multi-page viewports and pageIds are preserved.

3. In initializeScene's isCollaborationLink branch, include pages: scene?.appState?.pages ?? excalidrawAPI.getAppState().pages and activePageId: scene?.appState?.activePageId ?? excalidrawAPI.getAppState().activePageId in the object passed to restoreAppState.
4. In syncData (tab-focus localStorage sync), restore localDataState.appState first and pass validPageIds: appState.pages.map((p) => p.id) and defaultPageId: appState.pages[0]?.id to restoreElements.
5. In onUnload, pass excalidrawAPI.getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted().filter((el) => !el.isDeleted) to LocalData.fileStorage.shouldPreventUnload.

6. In onExportToBackend and all ExportToExcalidrawPlus / exportToExcalidrawPlus call sites, use all non-deleted elements across all pages via excalidrawAPI.getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted().filter((el): el is NonDeletedExcalidrawElement => !el.isDeleted) and ensure appState includes pages: appState.pages ?? excalidrawAPI.getAppState().pages.

Unit-test Scene active-page element isolation, all-page accessors, replaceAllElements merge vs replaceAllPages, insertElement activePageId stamping, and Store multi-page snapshot integrity.
rules: 1. Test Scene with elements across multiple pages and verify getNonDeletedElements, getElementsIncludingDeleted, getElementsMapIncludingDeleted, getElement, and getSelectedElements filter to activePageId while getAllElementsIncludingDeleted, getAllElementsMapIncludingDeleted, and getAllNonDeletedElements return all pages' elements.
2. Test Scene.insertElement stamps activePageId onto elements when activePageId !== DEFAULT_PAGE_ID and omits pageId when activePageId === DEFAULT_PAGE_ID without drawing extra randomId() calls.

3. Test Scene.replaceAllElements merges active-page updates while preserving other pages' elements in original order when replaceAllPages is false/omitted, and replaces the entire master array when replaceAllPages is true or when input elements span multiple pages.
4. Test Store.scheduleMicroAction and Store.commit preserve non-active pages' elements in snapshot.elements when active-page mutations occur.

tests.expect: scheduling and committing a mutation on page-2 keeps page-default elements intact in store.snapshot.elements

units.behaviour: Integration-test default page initialization, PageTabBar UI and actions, tombstone deletion, per-page element isolation and viewport preservation when leaving a page, per-element-page undo/redo filing across immediate page switches, single-page visual and embedded-scene export, multi-page JSON round-trip and legacy restore, and cross-page search.
rules: 1. Test AC-1: mounting <Excalidraw /> initializes appState.pages with a single default page { id: DEFAULT_PAGE_ID, name: 'Page 1', scrollX: 0, scrollY: 0, zoom: { value: 1 } }, appState.activePageId === DEFAULT_PAGE_ID, and renders PageTabBar with 'Page 1' active and delete button disabled.

2. Test AC-2 and AC-3: clicking the add-page button creates 'Page 2' and activates it; inline rename via page-rename-input updates the tab name on Enter/blur, ignores empty whitespace, and cancels on Escape; move-left/move-right reorders pages while keeping activePageId unchanged; deleting a page when pages.length > 1 marks its elements isDeleted: true with bumped version (tombstones) and activates the nearest remaining neighbor while deleting the last remaining page is prevented.

3. Test AC-4 and AC-5: elements created on Page 1 and Page 2 are isolated on the canvas (h.app.scene.getNonDeletedElements()), each page saves and restores its own scrollX, scrollY, and zoom when leaving and returning to the page, and undo/redo on Page 2 only undoes/redoes Page 2's changes without affecting Page 1's elements or undo stack.

4. Test cross-switch undo filing: edit an element on Page A, switch to Page B straight away before or around commit, and verify that undo on Page B does not undo Page A's edit while switching back to Page A and running undo undoes Page A's edit.

5. Test AC-6: exportToCanvas, exportToSvg, and exportToBlob on a multi-page scene render only the active page's elements, and when exportEmbedScene is true the embedded scene carries only the exported page's elements (without pageId) and no pages or activePageId.
6. Test AC-7: SearchMenu searches text and frame elements across all pages, shows page badges on multi-page matches, and selecting a match on another page switches activePageId to that page.

7. Test AC-8 and AC-9: serializeAsJSON and restore round-trip multi-page scenes (pages, activePageId, and per-element pageId), legacy payloads without pages or pageId restore to the single default page with zero extra randomId() calls, and orphaned element pageIds are reassigned to pages[0].id while cross-page bindings are stripped.

tests.name: initializes with a single default Page 1 and disables deleting the only page (AC-1)
tests.given: a freshly mounted Excalidraw component with no initialData.appState.pages
tests.expect: appState.pages has 1 page with id DEFAULT_PAGE_ID and name 'Page 1', activePageId is DEFAULT_PAGE_ID, and the delete button is disabled

tests.name: creates, renames, reorders, and tombstone-deletes pages via PageTabBar and actions (AC-2, AC-3)
tests.expect: adding pages creates Page 2 and Page 3, renaming updates the page name (or preserves it on empty input/Escape), reordering updates page order while preserving activePageId, and deleting an active page marks its elements isDeleted: true with bumped version and selects the nearest neighbor

tests.name: isolates elements and preserves per-page viewport and undo/redo history across page switches (AC-4, AC-5)
tests.given: a two-page drawing with elements and viewport changes on Page 1 and Page 2
tests.expect: switching pages saves outgoing scrollX/scrollY/zoom, swaps visible elements, and restores incoming scrollX/scrollY/zoom, and undo/redo on Page 2 only affects Page 2's elements while Page 1's undo stack remains intact

tests.name: files undo entries by the edited element's page when switching from page A to page B straight away (AC-5)
tests.given: an edit made on Page A followed immediately by switching to Page B before or during Store commit
tests.expect: undo on Page B does not undo Page A's edit, and switching back to Page A and invoking undo undoes the edit on Page A

tests.name: exports only the active page in visual exports and omits page list and pageId from embedded scenes (AC-6)
tests.given: a two-page drawing with a rectangle on Page 1 and an ellipse on Page 2
tests.expect: exportToSvg and exportToCanvas include only the active page's elements, and when exportEmbedScene is enabled the embedded scene contains only the active page's elements without pageId and omits pages and activePageId

tests.name: searches across all pages and switches to the matched element's page on selection (AC-7)
tests.given: a two-page drawing with text 'Alpha' on Page 1 and text 'Beta' on Page 2 while Page 1 is active
tests.expect: searching 'Beta' lists the match with Page 2's name and clicking the match switches activePageId to Page 2

tests.name: round-trips multi-page JSON and restores legacy and orphaned-pageId payloads cleanly (AC-8, AC-9)
tests.given: a multi-page scene serialized with serializeAsJSON, a legacy single-page payload without pages, and a payload with orphaned pageIds and cross-page bindings
tests.expect: restoring the serialized JSON preserves all pages, activePageId, and element pageIds; legacy payloads synthesize Page 1 and assign elements to DEFAULT_PAGE_ID; orphaned pageIds reassign to pages[0].id and cross-page bindings are stripped

units.behaviour: Test live collaboration page/element synchronization, encrypted Firebase room page list storage and reload, legacy peer fallback, and localStorage persistence across multiple pages.
rules: 1. Test AC-10: during collaboration in ExcalidrawApp, remote SCENE_INIT / SCENE_UPDATE payloads carrying pages and multi-page elements update local appState.pages and scene elements while keeping the local user's activePageId and viewport independent (unless the local user's active page was deleted remotely, in which case activePageId falls back to pages[0].id), and remote elements without pageId from legacy peers land on DEFAULT_PAGE_ID.

2. Test Firebase room page list persistence: saving a multi-page room via saveToFirebase encrypts and stores pagesIv and pagesCiphertext on the room document and loading via loadFromFirebase decrypts and returns the saved page list.

3. Test AC-11: saving to localStorage via LocalData / clearAppStateForLocalStorage and importing via importFromLocalStorage + restore preserves pages, activePageId, per-page scrollX/scrollY/zoom, and all pages' elements across reload.
